runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt:
The snippet snippets/quantity-input-labels.liquid renders a product quantity selector with accessible labels and quantity-rule hints. It is rendered with the parameters input_id, product_title, min, max and step, but many of its literal references are wrong, so Theme Check reports missing assets, missing translation keys and missing snippets. Fix every broken literal operand so that it points to a resource that actually exists. Read assets/, locales/en.default.json, locales/de.json and snippets/ to find the exact names. The intended targets are:
1. The stylesheet loaded with asset_url | stylesheet_tag must be the quantity component stylesheet in assets/.
2. The deferred script loaded with asset_url must be the quantity input JavaScript file in assets/.
3. The visible label must use the key whose English value is "Quantity".
4. The minus button aria-label must use the key whose English value is "Decrease quantity for {{ product }}"; the plus button aria-label must use the key whose English value is "Increase quantity for {{ product }}"; the number input aria-label must use the key whose English value is "Quantity for {{ product }}". Keep passing product: product_title and the escape filter.
5. The rule hints must use the keys whose English values are "Increments of {{ quantity }}", "Minimum of {{ quantity }}" and "Maximum of {{ quantity }}" respectively, keeping the existing quantity: arguments.
6. The minus button must render the minus icon snippet and the plus button must render the plus icon snippet.
All translation keys live under the nested path products > product > quantity in both locale files; use full dotted paths. Do not change markup, conditions, attributes, element order, filter arguments or whitespace other than the literal operands. When finished, Theme Check must report no missing asset, translation key or snippet errors. Change only snippets/quantity-input-labels.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
